title: Flashback to the year we got to -22 here in WA and decided to try thi...
description: Flashback to the year we got to -22 here in WA and decided to try this experiment! You will need to mix 1 cup warm water, 2.5 tablespoons corn syrup, 2.5 tablespoons dish soap, 2 tablespoons sugar and use straws to blow the bubbles. Now, how does this happen? “While it looks like the entire bubble is freezing, the bubble is actually comprised of three layers of liquid. There is a layer of water sandwiched in between two layers of bubble solution. The bubble’s surface and interior layer don’t freeze. The middle water layer is the portion that freezes and forms those crystalline patterns during the experiment as it freezes at a higher temperature than soapy water.“ Happy playing! #autismawareness #stem #learning #onthisday
